# KTX codec fixtures

These five files are unmodified fixtures from KhronosGroup/KTX-Software 4.4.2,
commit `4d6fc70eaf62ad0558e63e8d97eb9766118327a6`, `tests/testimages/`.
Copyright 2015–2022 The Khronos Group Inc. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0.
The upstream `REUSE.toml` applies this attribution/license to `*.ktx2` images.
The full Apache-2.0 license is included as `LICENSE.txt`.

They exercise real ETC1S, UASTC, UASTC+Zstd, authored RGBA+Zstd, and a seven-level
ETC1S mip pyramid. They are test inputs, never application runtime dependencies.

Upstream: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/KTX-Software/tree/v4.4.2/tests/testimages
